name: 时区转换（内置世界主要时区）

map.⏲️ 时区转换（内置世界主要时区）: ⏲️ Time Zone Converter (major world time zones built in)
map.世界主要时区换算（标准时间，不含夏令时）: Convert between the world's main time zones (standard time, daylight saving not included)
map.📖 查看「时区转换（内置世界主要时区） 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Time Zone Converter User Guide"
map.目标时间 = 源时间 − 源时区偏移 × 60 + 目标时区偏移 × 60（单位: Target time = source time − source offset × 60 + target offset × 60 (in minutes); days crossed = floor(result ÷ 1440), minute of the day = result taken modulo 1440 and normalized to 0-1439, then split into hours and minutes; during daylight saving another 60 minutes is added to the target offset (roughly March to November in the northern hemisphere) and must be corrected by local rules.
map.📚 深度解析：在世界主要城市时区之间换算时间、计算时差并展示世界时钟，辅助跨国沟: 📚 In-depth: converts time between major world cities, computes time differences and shows a world clock, helping schedule cross-border communication.
map.城市换算：选两城市互转时间。: City conversion: choose two cities and convert time between them.
map.时差计算：显示相差小时数。: Time difference: shows how many hours apart they are.
map.夏令时：标注夏令时偏移。: Daylight saving: marks the daylight-saving offset.
map.示例：北京 20:00 对应伦敦 12:00（冬令时，差 8h）。: Example: 20:00 in Beijing corresponds to 12:00 in London (winter time, 8h apart).
map.部分城市实行夏令时，工具标注其偏移。: Some cities observe daylight saving time and the tool flags that offset.
map.数据来源？: Where does the data come from?
map.依据 IANA 时区库主要城市定义。: From the major-city definitions of the IANA time zone database.
map.跨国会议、亲友通话与航班: Cross-border meetings, calls with family and friends, and flights.
